scope: Complete current and authenticated prior carrier, plus all twelve complete direct prerequisite sources. This is owner research evidence, not a native acceptance or whole-transitive-corpus audit.

steps.review: (I-Z_jZ_{j+1})/2 is a nonzero orthogonal projection, norm 1. Each site belongs to exactly two bonds, so M=2,R=1,kappa=2. hbar=1 is the stated dimensionless convention. Existing CC finite-range supplier applies.

Finite subsets of Z have an explicit countable enumeration via finite tuples. Each fixed sign/outside-F sector is the standard 2^|Lambda|-dimensional representation, with possible sign-dependent relabeling of spin basis. Consequently the direct sum has exactly the same local operator norm and the compatible star-representations extend to the quasi-local norm completion in B(H). No infinite tensor product was presumed.

A nonempty finite F has left/right endpoints and w(F)=2 times its interval-component count. Dense finite-support vectors and basis tests prove the diagonal nonnegative operator is self-adjoint on exactly sum w²|xi|²<infinity; Cauchy–Schwarz proves the converse adjoint inclusion.

Strong continuity uses summable 4|xi|². On D(K), derivative errors are dominated after squaring by 4w²|xi|², which is summable, using the scalar FTC bound |exp(itw)-1|<=|t|w. Conversely a Hilbert norm derivative forces its coordinate sequence iw xi to be square-summable. The zero eigenspace consists of the two empty-F basis vectors. For real lambda in (0,2), inverse denominators have the displayed positive bound and w/(w-lambda) is bounded; negative real/nonreal resolvents follow by the same diagonal estimates. A singleton F realizes eigenvalue 2, so the excitation gap is exactly 2.

All Ising bonds commute. In finite volume, factors disjoint from a local support cancel even in the full conjugation, leaving only adjacent bonds. On X_j the phase is exp(it(w(F triangle {j})-w(F))), matching U_t pi(X_j) U_t*. Z_j is fixed. Local Pauli words generate every local algebra and norm continuity extends the covariance identity to A. Thus this is the actual thermodynamic dynamics, not an unrelated diagonal group.

Omega is unit, in ker K, and fixed by U_t. The contractive star-representation makes its vector functional bounded, unital and positive. Its restrictions are the consistent equal mixture of the two product states (empty-region value 1). The local projector (I+sigma Z_j)/2 first selects the sign component of Omega, and product X_i generates |sigma,F>. A site j outside finite F exists (one may use the first such site in a fixed enumeration). Hence Omega is cyclic and the displayed gap belongs to the state representation itself.

Each phase has Z expectation +/-1 and distinct-site ZZ expectation 1; their equal mixture has zero one-point values and connected ZZ=1 for every integer r>=1. Any finite C0 and mu>0 give C0 exp(-mu r) tending to zero, contradicting the claimed bound. The two pure phase vector states are also distinct fixed positive-energy ground states. No conclusion about transport of an entire gapped ground band is changed.

boundary_checks.empty: Finite-region algebra at empty region is C with density 1; finite set F=empty gives both ground vectors.
boundary_checks.zero: Empty F gives zero energy; zero observables are harmless. Zero excitation gap is not used.
boundary_checks.one: Singleton F has exactly two domain walls and eigenvalue 2; single-site algebra has the explicit Pauli representation.
boundary_checks.degenerate: kerK is exactly two-dimensional; the failure mechanism is deliberately degenerate ground space, not a closing excitation gap.
boundary_checks.endpoints: All real t are allowed; norm derivative at t=0 is proved on the exact domain. Connected correlation is checked for every r>=1 and its large-r contradiction.
boundary_checks.choice: CC is explicit for Hilbert/norm completions and measure/FTC interfaces. Finite tuples and a single site outside F need no full AC; the conditional AC=>CC remark does not assert full AC.
boundary_checks.logical_scope: One actual counterexample refutes a universal implication. No converse clustering criterion or empirical material claim is inferred.
